text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! You mean you personally run 
the paths yourself to select the perimeter 
course for the Umamusume in your charge?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I figured feeling the actual run 
firsthand would help us identify a more 
effective course layout.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To run the exact same distance as an 
Umamusume just to understand how they feel 
when racing, even though you're a human 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all! I was just doing a 
little light running through key parts of 
the course—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's true that... running just a 
section of it and running the entire 
course through must feel completely 
different...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the valuable perspective! 
I'll definitely try putting it into 
practice next time!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Could it be—you've tested all kinds of 
other Umamusume training regimens on your 
own body as well?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: !? ...Indeed, it is just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If I truly care about Meek, I need to have 
that level of resolve— I'll give it a 
try...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh... Magnificent...!! The feature for 
the next issue is 'The Iron Will of a 
Prestigious Clan's Trainer'—that settles 
it!!
